items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: I gave him that little band up with Gilbert

ctx.x: I had George McCullum on the trumpet.

George McCullum. So George, he died. So George stood on the trumpet, played two or three jobs out there. Next time I played out there, well, I used Gilbert. George was couldn't get George. George played the last two jobs but Gilbert played the first job. Gilbert killed on the trumpet. Sam Dutray on the clarinet. George played the last two jobs, Gilbert played the first job, Gilbert Young on the trumpet, Sam Dutre on the clarinet. I had my sister Cecile on the piano and I had Sidney Fleuja. Remember Sidney Fleuja,…
I think we got it all. Did you name them all? I'm just making a note about him, Sidney Fleuja.
